The first group will being floating up and charging a line AoE attack (Bitter Regret) followed by the other set. This will be combined with a Bitter Regret from the boss itself, leaving the middle or sides safe after the last set of smaller line AoEs.

spawning a magical proximity AoE telegraph in the middle. In addition, three curving paths will appear in the arena edge AoE and lead to the wall. Each player must carefully move to the wall to mitigate the proximity damage. The proximity AoE has a very large falloff, so players must be directly at the wall or they take massive damage. The Bleeding from touching the dark red persistent AoE will increase the chance of the proximity damage being lethal unless there is quick healing.

The boss will face a random player and use a late telegraphed 180 degree frontal cleave. Get behind. Chilling Chirp will now summon two circle AoE telegraphs on opposite cardinals. Almighty Racket: Get behind. Three circle AoE telegraphs will then appear along with spread marker AoEs on each player (Sedimentary Debris) dealing magical damage. Spread out in the safe zone.

Spawns a proximity AoE telegraph dealing magical damage at the boss's feet. Players must move to the opposite side of the arena to mitigate. When it resolves, it will additionally spawn a fast-moving set of circle AoEs that will travel clockwise or counterclockwise along the ring, so players must dodge in the opposite direction. Anyone hit by these will be temporarily stunned and knocked up. Using Sprint is recommended. The AoEs will complete slightly less than one full rotation. For uptime, tanks may opt to remain in melee range and use an invulnerability cooldown, although it may not be possible to dodge the rotating AoEs that temporarily stun.

Spawns two sets of untargetable Sand Sphere adds, each of which will use a telegraphed point-blank AoE (Sphere Shatter). The first set has 7 spheres and the second set has 6. The boss will jump outside again and being moving around, so players will need to keep track of its location while dodging the AoEs.

The boss will brandish its glowing sword to its left or right, while a small purple wave of energy will appear at its feet on that side. It will then spawn six linked clones of itself in a hexagon, all with the same animation. The clones will then begin disappearing in a clockwise or counterclockwise pattern. The last clone to disappear will emit a half-room cleave from its location based on which side is glowing.

Spawns four untargetable Add Blocks in pairs outside of the arena. These will use a late telegraphed line AoE in front of them, leaving one quadrant of the arena safe. At the same time, the boss will cast Static Force, placing conal spread markers on everyone, so they should spread out in the safe quadrant. The spread resolve shortly after the line AoEs, so there is time to adjust back into the previously unsafe areas for more space.

The boss will tether two tiles with magenta tethers and the edge of the south two tiles with blue tethers. The magenta tethers will spawn a magenta orb on the tile, while the purple tethers will each spawn an electrope cube cluster that will travel along the blue tracks on the floor. When the cubes touch an orb, it will emit an untelegraphed plus-shaped AoE that will hit the row and column of tiles that the orb was on. For this first set, players can dodge into the first AoE towards the middle of the arena once it activates.

it's the same mechanic as Ancient Flare from the final boss in Labyrinth of Ancients formerly known as Acheron and now Phlegethon. Each group must stack on a small platform energized by the lightning orbs, which raises a shield that blocks the Daybreak cast. If stacking is not properly performed, then the shield fails.
